description: Triage (#391): of four findings, R1 (Important, a total computed before the loop ends) and R2 (Minor, a missing empty-file test) are a suggested fix naming one concrete change each, off the security axis and not about security in substance, about nothing the user specified: they go to the implementer at once with the Plan line, no ask, a Log line (never a Decisions row) and one status line. R3 (a suggested fix whose evidence leaves two designs open) and R4 (a suggested keep) are asked together; the stage stays triage while that ask is open.

graders.name: reads the review-pipeline skill before the first fix send
graders.rule: Send each automatic fix at once, without asking, to the owning session with `Plan: enter plan mode (EnterPlanMode) for this task before anything else; write nothing until the user approves the plan.`, as every assignment is, and leave it out of the ask.

the send carries the Plan line
